identificationModule.briefTitle: A Phase III Randomized Trial of Metformin vs Placebo in Early Stage Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Randomized Trial of Metformin Versus Placebo on Recurrence and Survival in Early Stage Breast Cancer

armGroups.label: Arm I
armGroups.description: Patients receive oral metformin hydrochloride twice daily (once daily in weeks 1-4). Treatment continues for up to 5 years in receptor positive (ER and/or PgR positive) subjects in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

armGroups.label: Arm II
armGroups.description: Patients receive oral placebo twice daily (once daily in weeks 1-4). Treatment continues for up to 5 years in receptor positive (ER and/or PgR positive) subjects in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.
